name: spec
description: Spec pipeline v7 — a small code program run by a trusted engineer, verified by executed evidence. Lifecycle: /spec:genesis (greenfield) → roadmap briefs → /spec:mocks → /spec:plan → /spec:run (build, then review, each driver-stepped with one fresh-context reviewer and a derived verdict) → /spec:release; plus /spec:status, /spec:doctor, /spec:enforce, /spec:fix. Changelog (last 3): 7.290.0 — The policy round at init: grounding contract gains an optional policy block (worktreePerSpec, directLaneToMain, mergeStrategy, testExpiry, ledgerCommitted, reviewService, models, riskTiers) with key-by-key defaults; /spec:init asks two policy rounds of four questions and writes the answers through init-gen generate, which validates the block and adds the run ledger to the ignore list when ledgerCommitted is false; generate --dry-run prints a permissions-and-files confirm before writing; init-gen policy-check and /spec:doctor check 24 report policy drift; the reviewer seat moves to fable at effort low. 7.289.0 — Dead stops in build, review, fix, release and merge no longer halt the run with a bare message: each now becomes a single question that carries a recommended default, so the session can accept it and continue. The review driver gains a repair-round mark for a stopped run, and the merge strategy is derived from merge-back inspect instead of being asked cold. 7.288.0 — catalog-inventory finds components.json by walking up from the recorded kit path (design.kit, else genesis design-paths.json) to the root, so monorepo hosts no longer get an empty catalog or an all-removed check; it refuses to overwrite a populated catalog with 'none' or report it all-removed, naming the folders searched; copied composition headings are demoted below the component heading (code fences untouched), so a fresh catalog re-checks as current.
